privacy.intro: ReKindle ni programu ya wavuti iliyoundwa kutoa dashibodi kwa vifaa vya E-ink. Tunapeana kipaumbele faragha yako na uwazi.
privacy.last_updated: Imesasishwa Mwisho: 24 Novemba 2026 (inabadilisha toleo la 24 Oktoba 2026)
privacy.retention.body:
Social content is automatically deleted after a retention period: KindleChat general messages, their stored translations and gallery entries after 30 days (the latest 50 messages are always kept); topic comments and neighbourhood posts after 90 days; an old topic left with no comments is removed after 90 days. Resolved or dismissed moderation reports older than 90 days are deleted, automated moderation logs older than 30 days, and moderation action logs older than 12 months. Direct messages are not automatically deleted.

You can permanently delete your account at any time from Settings > Delete Account. This removes your login, main-project data (notes, tasks, files, scores, suggestions and your mail configuration, including Microsoft sign-in tokens), your age-verification record and your social profile records. Your public social history (posts, comments, chat messages, direct messages, reports and artwork you shared) is kept and ages out under the retention periods above, and is shown as "Deleted User" with a blank avatar. Moderation records and IP-ban records may be kept where needed for safety or legal reasons. Stripe keeps payment records under its own policy.
privacy.retention.title: Uhifadhi wa Data
privacy.section.1.body:
ReKindle inafanya kazi kwa njia mbili:

  • Hali ya Mgeni: Taarifa za akaunti huhifadhiwa katika Hifadhi ya Ndani ya kivinjari chako. Hatutengenezi rekodi ya seva kwako katika hali ya mgeni, lakini programu bado zinawasiliana na huduma za pande tatu zilizotajwa katika Sehemu ya 6 (kwa mfano, kupata maudhui ya umma) na relays zetu wenyewe ambapo wakala (proxy) unahitajika. Ikiwa utafuta kumbukumbu ya kivinjari chako, data hii itapotea.
  • Hali ya Kuingia: Data za programu zinazoungwa mkono zinasawazishwa kwa usalama kwenye Google Firebase chini ya Kitambulisho chako cha Watumiaji cha kipekee. Tunafanya kazi na miradi miwili tofauti ya Firebase: Mradi wa Kwanza (rekindle-dd1fa) kwa programu na data nyingi, ikiwa ni pamoja na michoro yako ya Sanaa ya Pikseli na michoro ya Flipbook, na Mradi wa Kijamii (rekindle-socials) kwa vipengele vya kijamii: KindleChat (vyumba vya umma, ujumbe wa moja kwa moja, mhimili wa sanaa unaoshirikishwa na tafsiri za ujumbe zilizohifadhiwa), Jirani, Mada (pamoja na kura za kura) na rekodi za usimamizi. Hii inakuwezesha kufikia data yako kwenye vifaa vingi.

Uthibitisho wa Umri: Kupata huduma zote za kijamii kunahitaji uthibitisho wa umri. Tarehe yako kamili ya kuzaliwa (siku, mwezi na mwaka) na nchi yanahifadhiwa katika rekodi ya uthibitisho wa umri ya akaunti yako na katika madai ya alama yako ya uthibitisho ili kuthibitisha kuwa unakidhi kiwango cha chini cha umri. Yaliyomo ya kijamii (KindleChat, Neighbourhood, Topics na wasifu za kijamii) hayawezi kufikiwa hadi uthibitisho utakapothibitishwa. Rekodi huhifadhiwa mradi tu akaunti yako ipo na hutolewa unapoifuta akaunti yako.

Uhifadhi Kwa Watumiaji Tu wa Pro: Upakiaji wa faili na picha kwenye Hifadhi ya Firebase umepungiwa kwa wanachama wa ReKindle+ (Pro) pekee.

Uchambuzi: Tunatumia Counter.dev kwenye kurasa nyingi kwa uchambuzi wa maoni ya ukurasa kwa njia isiyo ya kibinafsi. Ziara huandika njia ya ukurasa, ukurasa wa kurejelea, ukubwa wa takriban wa skrini na tofauti ya eneo la wakati, bila cookies, data za akaunti au vitambulisho vya matangazo. Angalia Sehemu ya 6.

Uthibitishaji: Unapojisajili, jina lako la mtumiaji linatumika kuunda anwani ya barua pepe ya synthetiki ({username}@rekindle.ink) kwa Uthibitishaji wa Firebase. Usajili hauulizi anwani yako halisi ya barua pepe, nambari ya simu au kitambulisho cha serikali. Ikiwa unganisha sanduku la barua katika Mail, anwani hiyo ya sanduku la barua huhifadhiwa na akaunti (Sehemu ya 4), na Stripe inaweza kukusanya barua pepe ya malipo unapo lipa.
privacy.section.1.title: 1. Usanifu wa Data
privacy.section.2.body:
ReKindle inatoa ujumuishaji wa hiari na huduma za Google kuonyesha na kusimamia data zako binafsi kwenye kifaa chako.

  • Google Tasks: Ikiwa imewezeshwa, ReKindle inapata Google Tasks zako kuonyesha, kuunda na kukamilisha orodha zako za kazi.
  • Kalenda ya Google: Ikiwa itakayowashwa, ReKindle inapata Kalenda yako ya Google ili kuonyesha na kusimamia matukio yako.
  • Mawasiliano ya Google: Ikiwa imezimwa, ReKindle inasoma Mawasiliano yako ya Google (ufikiaji wa kusoma tu) ili kuonyesha kitabu chako cha anwani.
  • Ufikiaji: Programu inakuomba ruhusa ya kufikia data zako za Google tu baada ya kubofya wazi 'Ingia' (katika programu maalum au mipangilio) na kutoa ruhusa kupitia itifaki salama ya OAuth 2.0 ya Google.
  • Matumizi: Data hii inatumika pekee kutoa kipengele ulichounganisha, ndani ya dashibodi ya ReKindle.
  • Hifadhi: Kazi zako za Google, matukio ya Kalenda na Mawasiliano hayanakopiwi kwenye hifadhidata yetu. Vitambulisho vya kufikia kawaida huhifadhiwa kwenye Hifadhi ya Ndani ya kivinjari chako. Ubakaji mmoja: Quick ToDo huhifadhi kitambulisho chako cha kufikia Kazi za Google kwenye rekodi zako za akaunti binafsi ya Pro (pro_data/quicktodo) ili muunganiko ufuate kati ya vifaa. Mawasiliano ya Google pia huhifadhiwa kwenye Hifadhi ya Ndani ya kivinjari chako ili kitabu cha anwani kifungulie bila mtandao.
  • Uhifadhi na Ufutaji: Upande wa seva, tokeni ya Quick ToDo inafutwa wakati inapopita muda wake au unapokatisha usawazishaji wa Google. Tokeni za ndani na caching zinabaki kwenye kivinjari chako hadi ujiingie kutoka, kufuta data za tovuti au kuondoa ruhusa; caching ya mawasiliano haiondoshwi kwa kujiingiza kutoka. Unaweza kuondoa ruhusa ya ReKindle wakati wowote kupitia mipangilio ya usalama ya Akaunti yako ya Google.
  • Kushirikisha: Hatushirikishi data zako za mtumiaji wa Google na wahusika wa tatu wowote.

Matumizi ya ReKindle na uhamisho wake kwa programu nyingine yoyote ya taarifa zilizopokelewa kutoka Google APIs yatazingatia Sera ya Data ya Watumiaji ya Huduma za API za Google, ikiwa ni pamoja na mahitaji ya Matumizi Yaliyo Punguzwa.

Tunaweka Maktaba ya Mteja wa API za Google (apis.google.com) kwa ajili ya uthibitishaji wa OAuth na kupata Google Tasks/Kalenda/Wasiliana tu. Hakuna vidakuzi vya ufuatiliaji vinavyowekwa.
privacy.section.2.title: 2. Data za Mtumiaji wa Google (Kazi, Kalenda, Mawasiliano)
privacy.section.3.body:
We employ industry-standard security measures to ensure the confidentiality and integrity of your sensitive data.

  • Encryption in Transit: All data transmitted between your device, our servers, and third-party services (including Google APIs) is encrypted using Transport Layer Security (TLS/SSL).
  • Encryption at Rest: Any data synced to our database (as detailed in Section 4) is hosted on Google Firebase (Firestore & Realtime Database), which encrypts data at rest using 256-bit Advanced Encryption Standard (AES-256).
  • Encrypted Credentials: Mail passwords and the Substack session ID are encrypted with AES-256-GCM using a key derived from your account ID, which lets our server decrypt them to connect to the provider on your behalf. They are not end-to-end encrypted against ReKindle. Outlook sign-in tokens are stored in a server-only Realtime Database node that is never returned to the browser.
  • Secure Access: Access to personal data is restricted to the authenticated account, except for the public records described in Section 4 (your public profile, leaderboard entries, Suggestions and the banned-IP check below) and the ReKindle owner's administrative access. The owner can read private records and moderation data when needed for support, moderation, safety and maintenance, and can disable accounts, ban IP addresses and adjust ReKindle+ entitlements. We do not sell this data.

Automated Content Moderation: Text in KindleChat messages and captions, direct messages, Topics, Neighbourhood posts and comments is scanned by the OpenAI Moderation API (omni-moderation-latest) before publication, with innocent ASCII art emoticons removed first. Content is blocked when it exceeds our moderation thresholds. Pixel Art, Flipbook frames and their captions are not sent for automated image moderation and are reviewed only when reported. Suggestions, suggestion comments and Neighbourhood profile text are not pre-moderated. Rejections are logged in automod_log with the content type, the violation categories and up to 500 characters of text; private direct messages are redacted. These logs are readable only by the owner and are deleted after 30 days.

IP Bans & Timeouts: Your IP address is checked against a ban list on registration and login, and is recorded with your account and with password-reset audit entries. Banned IPs result in immediate account disabling and token revocation. A single ban entry can be read by anyone who knows the IP so the app can enforce a ban; in addition to the IP it may contain the banned account's username and user ID. The full list is readable only by the owner. Timeouts store an until timestamp and reason in the Realtime Database.

Reports & Moderation Records: Every report must include a reason and a comment with at least one real word (up to 500 characters; the in-app form allows 200). We store the report in the Social Realtime Database with your user ID and username, the reported user's ID, the content type, ID and path, the reason, your comment, a server-generated snapshot of the reported content (up to 2,000 characters), and the status and resolution. Reports are readable only by the ReKindle owner. The reported text may be re-checked by the OpenAI Moderation API as described above, but report details are not sent to any other third party. For a direct-message report, the report also stores the reported message and up to the last 10 messages of that conversation; there is no general moderator access to private conversations.

Report Outcomes: A chat message, direct message, topic comment, neighbourhood comment or suggestion comment is removed when a second, different user reports it or when automated moderation confirms the reported content. If moderation finds nothing, the report is held for review instead of deleting the content. Suggestions, topics and neighbourhood posts require two reports from different users. Reports and moderation actions are retained for moderation and audit purposes.

Rate Limiting & Spam Prevention: We store per-account counters and window start times for chat messages, topics, comments, neighbourhood posts, direct messages and direct-message requests, reports and mail. For chat and direct-message replies, the same record holds short hashes of recent message shapes so we can detect repeated or near-identical flooding, and three blocks within 10 minutes can mute chat for 10 minutes. These records are used only to throttle abuse and are not visible to other users.

Age Verification Custom Claims: Upon verification, Firebase Auth custom claims store ageVerified, ageVerifiedAt, ageVerificationCountry, ageVerificationThreshold and ageVerificationMethod on your authentication token. Claims also carry your Pro (pro) and moderator (moderator) status so social services can enforce access.
privacy.section.3.title: 3. Mbinu za Ulinzi wa Data
privacy.section.4.body:
If you create a ReKindle account, the following app data is stored in our database (Google Firebase) to enable sync features across your devices. Social app data is stored in the separate rekindle-socials project; all other data is stored in the primary rekindle-dd1fa project:

  • Tasks & Quick ToDo: To-do items created in the main Tasks app or generated via handwriting in Quick ToDo.
  • Quick Notes: Notes created in Quick Notes, including text produced by handwriting recognition, with creation and update timestamps. Notes are also cached locally for offline display.
  • Calendar (Native): Events added to the native calendar if Google Calendar is not enabled.
  • Contacts (Native): Contacts added manually to the native address book if Google Contacts is not enabled.
  • Notes: The text content, formatting, timestamps, and sorting preferences of your notes.
  • Library: Your library index, reading progress (CFI position), daily reading duration, and personal book reviews/ratings. The actual book files are stored locally in your browser cache (IndexedDB) to save bandwidth, but the metadata is synced.
  • Settings: General preferences, wallpaper selection, integration toggles, display mode, auto-scaling, font preferences (including OpenDyslexic), unit system, and your AI Assistant preferences. AI API keys stay on your device; connection credentials for Dropbox, Bluesky, Mastodon, Pinterest, Substack and Quick ToDo are stored in your private pro_data records (Pro users).
  • Mail (IMAP/SMTP and Microsoft OAuth): Your email account configuration (server addresses, ports, username and password), including several mailboxes per account. Passwords are encrypted with AES-256-GCM using a key derived from your account ID before storage. For Outlook.com, Hotmail and Microsoft 365, Microsoft issues a refresh token instead: we store it and the mailbox address on our server (mail_oauth, Admin-SDK only, never returned to the browser) and use it to fetch mail on your behalf. Email content is fetched from your mail server, or through our mail relay for Microsoft accounts, and is not stored on Firebase. Mail is available to ReKindle+ subscribers.
  • Clock: Your saved cities, alarms, and home location for the World Clock.
  • Crossword & Mini Crossword: Current puzzle state and grid progress.
  • Sudoku: Current puzzle state and pencil marks.
  • Nonograms (Picross): Puzzle progress and solved states.
  • Minesweeper: Current game state and timer.
  • Nerdle: Daily game state and guesses.
  • Chess & Checkers: Win/Loss/Draw statistics.
  • Leaderboards: High scores for Tetris, Snake, Pacman, Wordle, Spelling Bee, Dino, Maze, Tower of Hanoi, Lights Out, Trivia, Solitaire, Block Blast, Pet, Mario, Yahtzee, Perfect Circle, Crossy, Surfer, Jumpy, and Oregon Trail are visible to all signed-in users and linked to your username. Scores are written by our server after it validates the claimed value against a server-timed game run; the stored entry includes a server timestamp and a verified flag.
  • Interactive Reader: Your library of saved text adventures and reading progress.
  • Chords: Your saved songs and chord sheets.
  • Trivia: Your personal game history and statistics.
  • Habit Tracker: Your habits and completion history.
  • Stocks: The list of stock ticker symbols you are watching.
  • Cookbook: Recipes you save.
  • RSS Reader: Your subscribed feed URLs, names and categories.
  • Substack: Your Substack session ID (SID), encrypted with AES-256-GCM using a key derived from your account ID, to enable access to your paid subscriptions.
  • Reddit: Your list of saved subreddits.
  • Flashcards: Your decks, cards, and study intervals.
  • Countdown: Your saved event timers.
  • Spelling Bee: Your daily found words and puzzle statistics.
  • Words (Scrabble): Multiplayer game state and turn history.
  • KindleChat: Messages sent in public chat rooms, including replies (which store a short snapshot of the message being replied to) and emoji reactions (which store your user ID, username and chosen reaction), are stored in the Realtime Database to facilitate high-performance instant communication. The detected language of each message is stored so it can be translated.
  • Neighbourhood: Your profile information, posts and comments are stored to enable the community features. Your public profile may include: username, account email (your synthetic {username}@rekindle.ink address), bio, pronouns, gender, birthday, location, occupation, hometown, languages, favourite music/TV/movies/games/sports, interests, travel history, social links, avatar seed and pixel art avatar, a last-active timestamp and a private-profile toggle. Profile fields are visible to other age-verified users unless marked private.
  • Mindmap: Saved mindmaps and layouts.
  • Suggestions: Your submitted suggestions, problems, upvotes and comments, including your username, user ID and synthetic account email. The board and its comments are publicly readable, including without signing in.
  • Watchlist: Your saved movies and TV shows.
  • AirType: Your saved freewrite notes and writing sessions.
  • Pixel Art: Your saved drawings, canvas data, and manifest library.
  • Sheet Music: Your personal library of scores. (Note: Scores you explicitly upload to the 'Online Store' are public).
  • Flipbook: Your animations and drawing manifests are synced to enable cross-device editing.
  • Topics: Your saved topic subscriptions, reading preferences, and poll votes (the option you selected and when).
  • Food Log: Your categorized meals and daily food notes.
  • Journal: Your daily journal entries and reflections.
  • Live Multiplayer Games: Active game session state is stored in the Realtime Database for Chess, Checkers, Connect 4, Dots & Boxes, Pictionary, Tic-Tac-Toe, Uno, and Yahtzee.
  • Files & Docs: Your uploaded files and text document drafts (stored in Firebase Storage).
  • Teleprompter: Your saved speech scripts and scrolling preferences.
  • Spellbound: Your puzzle progress and stats.
  • Solitaire: Your leaderboard score (the saved game itself stays on your device).
  • Social Client Configs: Your connected social accounts, stored if you authorize them: Mastodon stores the instance URL and an encrypted access token; Bluesky stores your handle and an encrypted app password; Pinterest stores its OAuth tokens. Credentials are in your private pro_data records for Pro users.
  • Read Later: Your saved articles and reading list.
  • Life Calendar: Your life event entries and visual timeline data.
  • Age Verification: Your full date of birth (day, month, year) and country are stored to verify you meet the minimum age requirement for accessing social features. This record is kept while your account exists and is removed when you delete your account.
  • Account Credentials: Your synthetic email address ({username}@rekindle.ink) and hashed password for authentication. You may change your password at any time.
  • User Profile: Your public username, avatar/profile picture (pixel art or generated), and join date.
  • Dashboard: Your favorite apps layout and homepage preferences.
  • Books: Your reading log, reading duration, and personal reviews.
  • Weather: Your saved locations and weather display preferences.
  • Chat (AI Assistant): Your AI chat presets and conversation preferences.
  • ePub Reader: Your ePub reader settings and preferences, and the books you add to your ReKindle library (the book files stay on your device).
  • Pet: Your pet's public leaderboard entry (the live pet is kept on your device).
  • Dropbox: Your Dropbox OAuth token and synced file metadata.
  • Security & Abuse Prevention: Your IP address is recorded when registering and logging in. This is used strictly to enforce bans against serial offenders and prevent the creation of multiple accounts by abusive users. It is not used for external tracking or advertising.
  • KindleChat Direct Messages: Direct messages are stored in the separate rekindle-socials Realtime Database and are readable only by the two participants. Only ReKindle+ members can start a new conversation, and the recipient must accept it before messages can be exchanged. Each thread stores its participants, who requested it, its status (pending, accepted, declined or blocked), timestamps, and a per-participant index with the last-message time and your lastReadAt marker. Your allowRequests preference and your block list are stored so you can control who may contact you. Messages are text-only (up to 1,000 characters), screened by automated moderation, and may be reported; a report includes the reported message and up to the last 10 messages of that conversation for the moderation team. Direct messages are not end-to-end encrypted.
  • Shared Art Gallery: Pixel Art and Flipbook posts shared in KindleChat are added to a public gallery index visible to all age-verified users. The index stores your user ID, the art type, a thumbnail, any caption text and a timestamp. Removing the chat message, or a successful report that removes it, removes it from the gallery.
  • Game Runs & Anti-Cheat: When you open a supported game, we record a run (user ID, game, random run ID, start time and last submission time). When you submit a score, the server validates it against your previous best and the elapsed time. Implausible submissions are logged in a score_audit collection with your user ID, the game, the field, the claimed value and the maximum allowed value. These records are used only to keep leaderboards fair.
  • Reports & Moderation: Reports you submit (your user ID and username, the reported user's ID, content type/ID/path, reason, comment, content snapshot, status and resolution) are stored in the Social Realtime Database and are readable only by the ReKindle owner. Resolved or dismissed reports are deleted after 90 days; pending reports are retained while they need review.
  • ReKindle+ Subscription: Your subscription status (isPro), expiry date, Stripe customer ID or Checkout Session ID, subscription type (recurring, lifetime or gift year) and gift provenance. Your ReKindle+ status is shown publicly as a supporter crown next to your name in KindleChat, Neighbourhood and Topics. Card and payment details are handled by Stripe and are not stored by ReKindle.
  • Gift Codes: When you buy a ReKindle+ gift, we store the code, plan, the payment's Checkout Session ID and your user ID (so the code appears in your account). When it is redeemed we record the redeemer's user ID and time. Redemption attempts are counted per account to stop code guessing. Gift codes do not expire and are never automatically deleted.
  • Presence & Public Status: While you are signed in, we store whether you are online (presence) and a last-active time on your social profile. Other signed-in users can see this, your username, avatar and leaderboard entries, and your ReKindle+ supporter crown.
  • Password Reset & Security Events: A password change made without the current password writes a security audit entry containing the time, authentication time and IP address, plus a short-lived attempt window, so abuse can be investigated and rate-limited.
  • Cookie Clicker: Your game state is saved locally and backed up to your account so it survives a browser cache clear.
  • Photo Frame: Photos you upload are stored in Firebase Storage under your user ID, with an order file for the slideshow.
  • Library uploads: Interactive Reader stories and Sheet Music scores you upload to the public library are visible to other users and include your uploader user ID and title.
privacy.section.4.title: 4. Ulinganishaji wa Data wa Cloud wa Firebase
privacy.section.5.body:
Programu zinazofuata zinabaki na data zao za kazi tu kwenye kifaa chako maalum kupitia kivinjari localStorage au IndexedDB (au zinashikilia tu kwenye kumbukumbu), bila kujali hali ya kuingia. Michezo yenye orodha za viongozi pia huwasilisha alama iliyoelezwa katika Sehemu ya 4.

  • Kivinjari: Historia yako ya kuvinjari.
  • Lugha: Vitengo ulivyokamilisha, maendeleo ya somo, na takwimu za msamiati.
  • Amua: Chaguo na orodha ulizoihifadhi za maamuzi yako.
  • Sketchpad (Kitambaa cha jikoni): Michoro haihakikishiwi kuhifadhi kwenye hifadhi yoyote ya kudumu na hushafishwa wakati wa kutoka au kupakua upya ukurasa.
  • Chaguo la Pomodoro: Muda wako wa kazi/pause, idadi ya vipindi, lebo ya kazi ya sasa, na hali ya kisogezi zinahifadhiwa kwa ndani ili kufanya upya hasi kupoteza kipindi chako.
  • Kihesabu & Kigeuzi: Kihesabu hakihifadhi chochote. Kigeuzi kinahifadhi viwango vya kubadilisha kwenye kifaa (hakuna data binafsi).
  • Kupumua: Mipangilio ya kikao ni ya muda mfupi.
  • Michezo ya Mchezaji Mmoja: 2048 (Score ya Juu & Hali ya Mchezo), Wordle (Maendeleo ya Kila Siku), Jigsaw, Memory, Solitaire, Connections (Bindings), Tafuta Maneno, Anagrams, Hangman, Blackjack (Salio la Chips), Codebreaker, Doom, Yahtzee, Oregon Trail, Strands, Perfect Circle (score ya juu ya kibinafsi), Pacman, Crossy, Jumpy, Surfer, Cube Dash na Pet.
  • Michezo ya Kupitisha na Kucheza: Hali ya Mchezo kwa Battleship ya Wachezaji 2, Chess, Checkers, Connect 4, Tic-Tac-Toe, Texas Hold'em, na Pool haijaunganishwa na wingu.
  • Maandiko: Uendelezaji wa kusoma, alama za vitabu, na tafsiri zilizochaguliwa.
  • Vichekesho (vinachukua nafasi ya programu ya Manga): Maktaba yako ya vichekesho na maendeleo ya kusoma huhifadhiwa kiasili katika IndexedDB. Metadata ya vichekesho na picha za kurasa hupatikana kutoka Internet Archive.
  • Libby: Kadi zako za maktaba zinazounganishwa zinahifadhiwa hapa nyumbani; maudhui ya vitabu yanachukuliwa kwa usalama kupitia kiolesura cha Libby.
  • Readwise: Tokeni yako ya API na vivutio ulivyohifadhi vinahifadhiwa kwa ndani.
  • Framu ya Picha: Hali yako ya kuonyesha, muda wa kipande na mapendeleo ya muundo yamehifadhiwa kwa ndani. Picha zilizopakuliwa huhifadhiwa kwenye Hifadhi ya Firebase (tazama Sehemu ya 4).
  • Stopwatch: Hali ya kikao huhifadhiwa katika localStorage kama sehemu ya programu ya Timer.
  • Gazeti: Upendeleo wako wa ukubwa wa herufi.
  • Matokeo (Michezo): Timu zako na ligi unazozipenda kwa ajili ya programu ya Michezo.
  • Akinator: Hali ya mchezo (kipindi cha sasa na majibu yako) inahifadhiwa tu kwa mchezo unaoendelea na haikaiwi baada ya kuondoka kwenye ukurasa.
  • Michezo ya Gari: Maendeleo yako ya kazi, kikosi, na hali ya kila mchezo huhifadhiwa kwenye kifaa chako.
  • Mchezo wa mchezaji mmoja wa Battleship, Connect 4, Dots & Boxes, Tic-Tac-Toe, na Uno: Halisi ya mchezo inahifadhiwa tu kwenye kumbukumbu na hupotea unapotuacha au unapopandisha tena ukurasa.
  • Vidokezo vya Haraka (hali ya mgeni): Vidokezo vinahifadhiwa ndani. Vidokezo vya kuingia vinaendana kama ilivyoelezwa katika Sehemu ya 4.
  • Kalandari ya Maisha: Siku yako ya kuzaliwa imehifadhiwa ndani ili kalendari iweze kuonyeshwa bila mtandao; watumiaji walioingia pia wanaingiza data kama ilivyoelezwa katika Sehemu ya 4.
privacy.section.5.title: 5. Data ya Ndani Pekee
privacy.section.6.body:
ReKindle connects to the following third-party public APIs and services to provide functionality. These providers process requests under their own privacy policies:

  • Google Gemini, OpenAI and OpenAI-compatible providers: Used for the AI Assistant (Chat). Your prompts are sent to the selected provider through our secure proxy, or directly from your browser to a provider you configure (Groq, xAI, Mistral, Perplexity, Together AI, Fireworks AI or a local Ollama instance). Direct connections are user-configured and are not proxied through our servers.
  • Cloudflare Workers: Used to proxy requests for the AI Assistant, Quick ToDo and Quick Notes handwriting recognition, and various API calls.
  • Cloudflare Workers AI: Used for OCR text extraction from images in Quick ToDo and Quick Notes. Base64-encoded images are sent to @cf/meta/llama-3.2-11b-vision-instruct.
  • OpenAI Moderation: Used to check social text (messages, direct messages, topics, posts and comments) for policy violations. Images and artwork are not sent to this API.
  • Project Gutenberg: Used by the Reader's Gutenberg tab to search for and download public-domain books through our Gutenberg proxy.
  • Standard Ebooks: Used by the Reader's Standard Ebooks tab to fetch RSS feeds and book files. Requests are relayed through our Firebase Cloud Function because standardebooks.org blocks Cloudflare egress.
  • Open Library: Used for book search and cover images.
  • Google Books API: Used for book search.
  • DictionaryAPI & Wiktionary: Used by the Dictionary app for definitions.
  • Open-Meteo: Used for weather forecasts, location search and geocoding.
  • Yahoo Finance: Used to fetch stock quotes.
  • CoinCap: Used to fetch cryptocurrency prices.
  • OpenStreetMap, Stadia Maps & OpenMapTiles: Used by the Maps app for map tiles. Geocoding uses Open-Meteo and routing uses OSRM (project-osrm.org).
  • Reddit: Used to fetch public posts and comments.
  • Substack: Used to fetch public newsletter content and articles.
  • Dropbox: Used to sync files if you connect your Dropbox account.
  • Wikipedia & Wiktionary: Used to fetch daily history events and encyclopedia articles.
  • GitHub: Used as a data source for Crossword, Spelling Bee and the Quran text, and for Sheet Music files hosted on GitHub Pages.
  • rss2json: Used by the Newspaper, Topics, and RSS Reader apps.
  • Open Trivia Database: Used by the Trivia app for questions.
  • Stripe: Used to securely process payments for ReKindle+.
  • Mastodon & Bluesky APIs: Used by their respective client apps to view your social timelines and post updates directly to those federated networks.
  • MyMemory: Used by the Translator, KindleChat and Neighbourhood to translate text in your browser. Text you ask to translate is sent to MyMemory. Tatoeba supplies example sentences in the Languages app.
  • Microsoft: Used for Outlook.com, Hotmail and Microsoft 365 sign-in in Mail. The device-code and token exchange happen at login.microsoftonline.com, and mail is read and sent through Microsoft's IMAP/SMTP endpoints using the token Microsoft issues.
  • Internet Archive (archive.org): Used by the Comics app for public-domain comic search, metadata, covers, and page images.
  • Readwise API: Used to fetch your saved highlights and reading list.
  • Pinterest API: Used to fetch your saved pins and boards.
  • Bible API: Used by the Scriptures app to fetch religious texts.
  • Quran text data: Used by the Scriptures app to fetch Quran texts from a public dataset hosted on GitHub.
  • TMDB (The Movie Database): Used by the Watchlist app for movie/TV search and metadata.
  • ESPN: Used by the Scores app to fetch live sports scores for its leagues. NRL scores are served by a dedicated ReKindle endpoint.
  • chess-api.com: Used by the Chess app for engine suggestions; the current board position is sent to it.
  • US National Weather Service (api.weather.gov): Used by the Weather app for active weather alerts.
  • Libby (libbyapp.com): Loaded in an embedded frame in the Libby app so you can sign in to your library service.
  • TheMealDB: Used by the Cookbook app for recipe search.
  • IFDB & IFArchive: Used by the Interactive Reader app for interactive fiction catalog and downloads.
  • GuitareTab: Used by the Chords app for guitar tab search.
  • DuckDuckGo HTML: Used by the Reader worker for article search.
  • NY Times: Used by the Wordle and Strands apps for daily puzzle data.
  • Iconify: Used for icon search and display.
  • QR Server: Used by the AirType app to generate QR codes.
  • IPify: Used to fetch your public IP address for IP ban enforcement checks.
  • Open Exchange Rates: Used by the Converter app for currency conversion rates.
  • Counter.dev: Used for anonymous page-view analytics on most pages.
  • Akinator: Used by the Akinator game. Your yes/no answers and character guesses are sent to Akinator's servers (region-specific akinator.com domains) through a ReKindle-operated relay (hosted by Northflank) so it can ask the next question. Akinator sessions are not linked to your ReKindle account.

CDN Libraries: We load open-source JavaScript libraries from public CDNs including cdn.jsdelivr.net, cdnjs.cloudflare.com, unpkg.com, and gstatic.com. These libraries include Firebase SDKs, marked.js, chess.js, Dropbox SDK, localForage, JSZip, EPUB.js, Mammoth, docx, FileSaver, QRCode, html5-qrcode, gif.js, OpenSheetMusicDisplay, Tone.js MIDI, Leaflet, MapLibre GL and CKEditor. These CDNs may log your IP address per their own policies.

privacy.section.7.body:
If you have questions about this policy, or want to access, correct, export or delete your data, contact contact@ukiyomusic.com.

Depending on where you live, you may also have the right to object to or restrict certain processing. We respond to requests within a reasonable period and may ask you to verify that you control the account. Our service providers (Google Firebase, Cloudflare, Microsoft, Stripe and OpenAI) may process data outside your country, including in the United States, under their standard contractual safeguards.

We will post material changes to this policy on this page and update the date above. Continuing to use ReKindle after a change means you accept the updated policy.
